title: The Universal Testimony Of The Cosmos 18th Degree 1st Truth Turning To The Totality Of The Cosmos

questions.question: What does the traveler want to do next to grow stronger in faith?
questions.answer: He wants to look at the whole universe and learn from it.

questions.question: What tool does he use to look at the universe in a deeper way?
questions.answer: He uses a wide, special way of seeing learned from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are two things the universe is compared to?
questions.answer: A book and a palace.

questions.question: How does the universe show meaning and order?
questions.answer: Its parts change in a wise and organized way.

questions.question: What do these ordered changes show about the One who made everything?
questions.answer: That He knows everything and has power over everything.

questions.question: Who is described as writing the book of the universe?
questions.answer: A glorious Creator who sees all things and knows how they fit together.

questions.question: Which parts of the universe give this message?
questions.answer: Its kinds, tiny pieces, living things, and all that comes in and goes out.

questions.question: What do all these parts say together about the Maker?
questions.answer: That there is one great Maker.

questions.question: What qualities of the Maker are mentioned?
questions.answer: Greatness, no equal, endless power, and perfect wisdom.

questions.question: How many big truths are said to support the witness of the universe?
questions.answer: Two big truths.

questions.question: Why does the traveler turn to the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: To reach another level of faith.

questions.question: What does he hope will happen to the lessons he already learned?
questions.answer: They will become more complete and full of light.

questions.question: When he looks carefully, what does the cosmos seem like?
questions.answer: It seems like a living book, a beautiful palace, and an orderly city.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the cosmos: messy or well-planned?
questions.answer: It is well-planned.

questions.question: What do even the smallest parts of this great “book” help show?
questions.answer: They help show that there is a Creator.

questions.question: What do the ongoing changes in the world point to?
questions.answer: They point to a Knower and Powerful Maker.

questions.question: How well does this Maker know things?
questions.answer: He knows all things and how they connect.

questions.question: Do only big things in the universe give this message, or big and small things together?
questions.answer: Big and small things together.

questions.question: What do the creatures and particles say in one voice?
questions.answer: That there is one Maker and one Lord.

questions.question: Why is the witness of the cosmos called very great?
questions.answer: Because it is as vast as the whole universe.

questions.question: What is the main goal of the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: To increase his faith.

questions.question: Where does he go for a new lesson after learning from parts of creation?
questions.answer: He goes to the whole universe.

questions.question: What does the universe look like to him because it is full of meaning and order?
questions.answer: Like a written book and a carefully made home.

questions.question: What kinds of changes happen in the universe that still show order?
questions.answer: Changes that keep happening in a meaningful and wise way.

questions.question: What do all things in the cosmos together agree on?
questions.answer: The existence and oneness of the Maker.

questions.question: What is special about the Maker besides power?
questions.answer: He works with wisdom.

questions.question: Is the Maker shown as having an equal, or as being without equal?
questions.answer: He is without equal.

questions.question: What supports the strong witness of the cosmos at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Two huge truths.

questions.question: What does the traveler say before he studies the cosmos?
questions.answer: He says he should keep going to gain more faith.

questions.question: What does he want to listen to from the cosmos?
questions.answer: Its message.

questions.question: How does the Qur’an help him look at the world?
questions.answer: It gives him a clear way to understand it.

questions.question: Name one picture used for the universe in the passage.
questions.answer: An organized city.

questions.question: What do the “pages” and “lines” of the universe stand for?
questions.answer: The many parts of creation.

questions.question: What do these many parts show by changing again and again in a meaningful way?
questions.answer: They show a Creator is present and active.

questions.question: What can the Creator see, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Everything in everything.

questions.question: What can the Creator know, according to the passage?
questions.answer: How all things are linked to one another.

questions.question: What else besides living things gives witness in the cosmos?
questions.answer: Tiny particles and whatever enters and leaves it.

questions.question: What do the wise renewals in the world show about the Maker’s way of working?
questions.answer: He works with power and wisdom.

questions.question: What is the traveler trying to perfect and brighten?
questions.answer: His lessons of faith.

questions.question: Does he study only one small part of the world, or the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: The whole cosmos.

questions.question: Why is the cosmos compared to a book?
questions.answer: Because it is full of meaning.

questions.question: Why is it compared to a palace or a city?
questions.answer: Because it is beautiful and orderly.

questions.question: What do the changing parts of the universe say without words?
questions.answer: That a knowing and powerful Creator made them.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Creator’s knowledge?
questions.answer: It reaches all things.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Creator’s power?
questions.answer: It has no limit.

questions.question: What do all species and particles do together?
questions.answer: They give one shared witness.

questions.question: What is that shared witness mainly about?
questions.answer: The existence and oneness of Allah.

questions.question: How strong is this witness from the cosmos?
questions.answer: It is extremely great, as great as the cosmos itself.

questions.question: What does the traveler hope to gain from looking at the universe?
questions.answer: Another step in faith.

questions.question: What does he do after deciding to move forward?
questions.answer: He studies the cosmos and listens to its lesson.

questions.question: What makes the cosmos look like something written and arranged?
questions.answer: Its meaning and order.

questions.question: What does an arranged world help us understand about its Maker?
questions.answer: That the Maker is wise and careful.

questions.question: What do the parts of the universe keep doing that shows purpose?
questions.answer: They keep changing and being renewed in a meaningful way.

questions.question: What does this teach about the One who made the universe?
questions.answer: He knows all things and has power over all things.

questions.question: Which things in the cosmos are included in this testimony?
questions.answer: Every kind, every tiny part, all who live in it, and what comes and goes.

questions.question: What do these all declare together?
questions.answer: One exalted Maker made them.

questions.question: What two beautiful qualities are joined in the Maker’s work?
questions.answer: Power and wisdom.

questions.question: At the end of the passage, what is said to confirm the witness of the cosmos?
questions.answer: Two vast truths confirm it.
